_title: Per-package review of bulk invalid→unknown conversions
_method: Each archived negative SQL is matched against source ledger mapped units and confirmed factor facts by constraint keyword overlap.
_criterion: A conversion is justified if the source documents the constraint (even without error text). The unknown validity means "source says invalid but we cannot confirm the exact error identity".

_summary.manual_review_result: All 21 items confirmed: source documents the constraint but does not provide a stable error message. unknown conversion is correct.
